in_sanskrit.name: वीरेन्द्र
in_sanskrit.meaning: वीर (valiant, heroic) + इन्द्र (Indra, king of gods)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who possesses the qualities of a valiant hero and the power of the king of gods, Indra.

in_hindi.name: वीरेंद्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who possesses the courage and bravery of a hero and the divine power of a god, Indra.

in_tamil.name: வீரெந்திர
in_tamil.meaning: வீரம் (ஜோஜ்மையாள்வர், valiant) + இந்திரம் (இங்கோத்தமர், king of gods)
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who possesses the valiant qualities of a hero and the royal power of Indra, the king of gods.

in_telugu.name: వీరేంద్ర
in_telugu.meaning: వీరము (జోజ్జేశ్వరు, valiant) + ఇంద్రము (ఈశ్వరు, king of gods)
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who possesses the valiant qualities of a hero and the divine power of Indra, the king of gods.

in_marathi.name: Veerendra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Veerendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is brave and victorious in battles. A warrior king.

in_bengali.name: Veerendra
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Brave, Victorious
in_bengali.long_meaning: Veerendra একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is brave and victorious in battles. A warrior king.
